egress.terms: Free/unmetered playback from Skool's CDN. Private files on `assets.skool.com` return 403 and get signed URLs minted on download, so the read path is not a public CDN.

record.tooling: No official API. A community reverse-engineering effort exists (skool-api.cristiantala.com) using playwright + Google's Browserless actor with cookie auth; the `files:uploadImage` actor is documented empirically, not by Skool.
record.chaining: N free communities? No. Skool is $9/mo hobby or $99/mo pro after a 14-day trial, so the multiplier is paid seats, which fails the 'free' premise.
record.limits_note: 30 GB per video file; ~10 MB per image; uploads only through the web/mobile UI; private assets require on-demand signed URLs.
record.reliability_note: Paid commercial platform without programmatic API upload endpoints. Supports up to 30 GB per uploaded video file.

evidence.proved: 'Skool accepts up to ~10 MB per image (empirically — not documented). Above that, the upload returns a 413.'; 'assets.skool.com/... URLs for private files return 403'
